review_scope: Independent mathematical and source-code inspection of the finite morphology/count/lazy-cut model, plus five invented executable checks. No actual target domain or fit was invoked by this reviewer.
findings: All word factorizations use every 0<=i<j<=len(word), preserving a nonempty root and possibly empty affixes.

Semantic-root variables are shared by family and semantic value; prefix/suffix variables are shared by family and global role class. No extra root/affix distinctness or boundary gauge restriction is introduced.
Global form injectivity, distinct record paragraphs, exact first-word heads and positive/zero occurrence-count tables implement the registered necessary model.
Every retained full witness is replayed by complete global-word-type projection and by its morphology equations.
Each invalid binary projection adds only its necessary record-paragraph/form-A-value/form-B-value forbidden tuple.
Queries clone the original model plus globally necessary cuts; the one alternative-value restriction is not retained for subsequent queries.

Fixed source, target, separate model-specification, role-compiler and frozen domain-gate hashes are now enforced before CP model construction; each compressed domain artifact is bound to the frozen gate receipt.
Timeout and non-feasible solver statuses remain UNKNOWN; an unreplayed count-model candidate is not returned as a valid witness.

corrected_before_fit.issue: Initial main function merely recorded current input hashes without enforcing the frozen source/model/target/domain bindings.
corrected_before_fit.resolution: Reviewed updated fixed hash gates and per-case compressed domain binding; scientific model unchanged.

execution: Python3 with separately prepared OR-Tools dependencies; only invented inputs were passed to ExactModel.
proof_of_binary_cuts: With equal individual multiplicities, two unequal words have unequal next symbols A/B after their longest common prefix. Their projections to {A,B} then differ. Therefore individual counts and all binary projections determine the complete projected word. A violated pair forbids the specific paragraph and two word values independently of other values and of any particular factorization.
limits: The executable fixtures supplement bounded code inspection; they are not a general formal verification of OR-Tools or every possible solver input.

All value and paragraph queries in fit.py are conditional on one fixed role partition. Cross-partition universal claims require comparison over the complete ten-case union using semantic roles, not merely matching class-index form names.
A complete surface lexicon does not imply identified root boundaries or affixes; the model includes their finite factorization ambiguities.
Model construction itself is not interruptible by its internal query deadline. The runner supplies an outer process timeout; a killed or absent result must remain unresolved.
No primary manuscript fit or independent full negative result validation was performed in this code review.
